subject.why: The bicycle, newspapers, basket, bell, and fence are all present.

category.why: The fence extends across the entire background instead of remaining a minimal ground element.

clean.why: There are no text elements, UI, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The composition crowds the side edges, leaving insufficient lateral margins.

colour.why: Colors are saturated and warm with solid contrast.

detail.why: Forms are chunky and simple without distracting micro-textures.

style.why: Smooth, rounded 3D render style matches the references well.

fix: Scale down the bicycle to add side margins and reduce the fence to a small prop so it does not block the sky.
